name: Layered Blocker Marbles
description: Some boxes hide 3 neutral blocker marbles among their colored ones. Blockers can never be served, so they crowd the conveyor — but the moment 9 of them are riding the belt at once, the orange charger in the middle of the conveyor sweeps all 9 off in one burst and resets, ready to fill again.
howToPlay: Every cell is a box, so you dig from the bottom up — tap a box to empty it and reveal the one above. Six boxes are gray-striped blocker boxes (with a little lock). Blocker marbles can't be served and pile up on the belt; watch the orange charger in the center of the conveyor fill one pip per blocker. When 9 are riding the belt it sweeps all 9 off and resets. There are 18 blockers, so it fires twice. Sort all the colored marbles to win (heads up: a fully packed board is a LOT of marbles to clear).
author: Ilayda Arslan

showcaseLevel.name: Full Maze Charger
showcaseLevel.desc: Every cell filled; 6 blocker boxes feed the orange charger.
